sourceContradictions.details: Official display is 26 km; Naturkartan segment labels total 25.1 km; assembled Naturkartan/KML mainline computes 25.003 km; OSM computes 25.785 km; E1 and Pacer report about 25.9 km. Use official 26 km display and preserve computed lengths for normalization.
Skaraborgsleder title says Röå, while Västsverige and Naturkartan clarify Röåsjön as the functional start. Use Röå / Röåsjön label with official geometry coordinate.
OSM wiki row says Etapp 4: Röå-Lunnakulle even though it links relation 1251177, which currently has name/from/to for Röå-Lunnakulle-Hjo and reaches Hjo. Treat wiki label as stale/truncated.

General trail text says fire bans always apply in reserves, but current Länsstyrelsen reserve guidance varies. Hjoåns dalgång and Röå alsumpskog explicitly prohibit fire; Stora Röå current listed rules do not include a blanket no-fire rule.
Visit Hjo stage page mentions lines 402 and 405. Current Västtrafik evidence favors 402, 406, 415 and sparse/preordered 435; treat line 405 as stale until planner confirms.
Official map stop-direction coordinates differ materially, while PDF says the stop is about 200 m west of the trail. Use Västtrafik stop coordinates during normalization.
A mapped Hjoåns dalgång fire/rest point exists, but reserve rules include no fire. Import-risk follow-up on 2026-04-29 found no public evidence of a legal exception or outside-boundary placement.
sourceContradictions.recommendedHandling: Keep this feature suppressed or pending; do not import it as a usable public fireplace unless boundary overlay or official clarification proves legal use.

sourceContradictions.details: Stämmorna cluster is named in official stage split context and has verified facilities, but sits about 265-295 m from the stage-4 line. Decide connector modelling before importing as on-route.
